description: shadcn-svelte's scroll-fade utilities as Tailwind CSS 4 compiles them, in the five scroll-fade examples: registered <length-percentage> custom properties animated by scroll-driven animations (scroll(self y), scroll(self inline); ranges 0 96px and calc(100% - 96px) 100% through var() fallbacks; ease-in-out, fill both) into a mask-image linear-gradient with mask-composite: intersect; the fade sizes (min(12%, 40px), scroll-fade-4, scroll-fade-24), scroll-fade-none, an inactive timeline (content that does not overflow), hidden scrollbars (no-scrollbar). Wheel turns to the middle and the end of each scroller
